name: Lamb Chops with Minty Cucumber & Tomato Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place the lamb chops on a plate; rub with olive oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 lamb rib chops
6 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
3 small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Cut the cucumber in half crosswise, then cut quarter lengthwise into 4 wedges; cut the wedges crosswise into bite-sized chunks. Transfer to a large bowl.
Halve the tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Pick the mint leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Stack the leaves and cut crosswise into thin ribbons; add to the bowl.
Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat.
While the pan/skillet heats up, peel and small dice the onion; add to the bowl.
Place the lamb chops on the grill or skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2 to 5 minutes per side.
Halve the lemons and juice half over the salad. Cut the other half into wedges for serving.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place the salad on plate, add the lamb chops on the side, and squeeze the lemon wedges over the lamb. Enjoy!
